# ONRUF Central Control Panel – AI Agent Playbook
- **Architecture** Static HTML shells (`index.html`, `login.html`, `complete-registration.html`) pull vanilla JS/CSS from `assets/`; no bundler, so edit files in place and open them directly or via a static host.
- **Entry States** `index.html` always loads `assets/js/onruf-central-control-panel.js` (~23k LOC) while auth pages load `assets/js/onruf-auth.js`; both expect the DOM IDs/classes already present in the templates.
- **Local Storage** The dashboard script declares top-level datasets (`roles`, `users`, `categories`, `specifications`, `productAds`, `productAdAutomation`, `individualAccounts`, `businessAccounts`, `businessPackages`, `businessSubscribers`, `financeTransactions`) plus a large `state` object; always update data through the provided `normalize*Payload` → `save*ToStorage()` → `render*/sync*` pipeline.
- **Session Guard** `initializeApp()` starts with `enforceActiveSession()` and `ensureSessionUserIsActive()`; missing or inactive users trigger `redirectToLogin()`, so keep `users[n].status` and `accountType` accurate when editing seeds.
- **Seed Resets** `ensureSeedDataReset()` and `ensureCategoryDatasetCleared()` compare the persisted versions (`DATA_RESET_VERSION`, `CATEGORY_RESET_VERSION` and matching `*_RESET_KEY`s). Bump those constants when default payloads change to purge stale localStorage.
- **Auth Seeds** `assets/js/onruf-auth.js` seeds `localStorage.onruf_users_v1` and writes active sessions to `sessionStorage.onruf_active_session_v1`. Use `hashPassword()` (Base64 of UTF-8 bytes) when adding passwords—`verifyPassword()` depends on that exact format.
- **Invitation Flow** OTP + invite links run through `generateOtp()`, `deliverInvitationEmail()`, and `buildAbsoluteInvitationLink()`. The service endpoint resolves via `window.__ONRUF_CONFIG__.invitationServiceUrl`; expose that global before loading scripts if the UI is hosted away from the Node helper.
- **Optional Backend** See `README.md` for the SMTP microservice in `server/` (not versioned). Run `npm install` then `npm start` from that folder and load `http://localhost:4000/index.html` so `/api/invitations/send` matches the browser origin.
- **Roles Module** `renderRolesTable()`, `openRoleBuilder()`, `setRoleBuilderMode()`, and `handleRoleFormSubmit()` drive CRUD. Keep dual-language names and clone `permissionSectionsTemplate` via `buildPermissionCatalog()` before mutating permissions.
- **Users Module** `normalizeUserPayload()`, `ensureUserInvitationRecord()`, `backfillMissingUserCreators()`, and `setUserBuilderMode()` populate audit fields and sidebar counts. Invitation actions call `regenerateUserInvitation()` → `deliverInvitationEmail()`; align auth + dashboard scripts if you tweak delivery metadata.
- **Registration Mirror** `state.registrationFlow` mirrors invitation state for the sidebar badge. Call `updateRegistrationLinkDisplay()` whenever invitation tokens, OTPs, or completion timestamps change.
- **Category Tree** Category modals use `buildCategoryModalHierarchy()` + `renderCategoryModalTree()` with depth/fee constants (`CATEGORY_MAX_DEPTH`, `CATEGORY_AD_FEE_*`). After category changes run `syncCategorySpecificationCounts({ persistCategories: true, persistSpecifications: true, refreshView: true })` to keep specs aligned.
- **Specifications** `renderSpecificationList()` expects Arabic + English labels and links categories via selector helpers (`initializeSpecificationCategoriesPicker()`). Missing translations render blank cells, so populate both fields.
- **Product Ads & Automation** Lists live in `state.productAdDecisionContext`; create entries with `normalizeProductAdPayload()` or `normalizeAutomationEntry()` and persist with `saveProductAdsToStorage()` / `saveProductAdAutomationToStorage()`.
- **Accounts Directory** Individual + business directories share pagination and filters inside `state`; CRUD flows render via `renderIndividualAccountsTable()` / `renderBusinessAccountsTable()` and must keep filter state synchronized when toggling `.sub-app-btn` targets.
- **Finance Workspace** Use `state.financeFilters`, `renderFinanceTransactionsTable()`, `renderFinanceInsights()`, and `renderFinanceAuditTimeline()`; overlays expect ISO-style amounts/dates, so reuse `exportFinanceTransactions()` + `handleFinanceImportInputChange()` instead of custom parsing.
- **Event Binding** `setupEventListeners()` marks bound nodes with `dataset.bound = 'true'`; follow that pattern for new listeners to avoid double-binding after re-renders. Inline `onclick` handlers usually delegate into the same helper functions.
- **Shared Overlays & Indicators** Overlay helpers (`setup*Overlay`, `open*Overlay`, `close*Overlay`) and `applyRequiredFieldIndicators()` rely on existing IDs/data attributes. Extend them instead of introducing new selectors.
- **Styling Contract** `assets/css/onruf-central-control-panel.css` and `assets/css/onruf-auth.css` assume existing class hooks (`.status-badge`, `.tree-node`, `.user-chip`, `.period-btn`). Changing markup requires corresponding CSS updates.
- **Diagnostics** Both scripts log to `console.warn` when storage fetches fail or invitation delivery is skipped. If the UI looks stale, clear `localStorage` and `sessionStorage` for the origin to trigger reseeding.
- **Manual QA** There are no automated tests; after auth or dataset changes verify `login.html`, `complete-registration.html`, and `index.html` flows with the seeded super admin (`superadmin@onruf.com` / `Admin@123`).
